prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you mean spray (sunless) tanning or UV tanning (beds)? Also, what part of Charlotte are you in or near (South End, Ballantyne, University City, etc.)? That will let me recommend the best nearby salons.

While you answer, here are quick tips and what to look for so you pick the “best” place for your needs:

What to choose
- Spray (sunless) tanning: safest alternative to UV; look for spray techs who do a color consult and offer custom shades. Good if you want even, natural-looking color without sun damage.
- UV beds: faster buildup but increases skin cancer/aging risk. Choose salons with modern, well-maintained beds and staff who screen skin types and limit exposure.

How to pick a salon
- Reviews and photos: check recent Google, Yelp, Instagram before/after photos.
- Technicians: for spray tans, ask if techs are certified and what system they use (airbrush vs automated; brands like VersaSpa, Norvell, St. Tropez are common).
- Cleanliness & maintenance: beds should be clean and all equipment functioning.
- Patch test: reputable spray salons offer or recommend a patch test for first-timers.
- Pricing & packages: compare per-session and membership costs.
- Customer service: timely responses, clear prep and aftercare instructions.
- Safety: especially for UV, confirm staff follows exposure guidelines and discloses risks.

If you want, tell me spray vs UV and your neighborhood and I’ll list 4–6 highly rated salons in Charlotte and what each is known for.
